title: Early pay-in of securities to ICCL (EPN)
purpose: Client sales paid in early to BSE Clearing: settlement, the firm's own clearing number as TM code, client, ISIN and quantity.
source: ICCL circular 20200829-4 (early pay-in cut-offs), as restated in BSECL's cut-off table and the cash master circular para 5.a: early pay-in of securities and funds by EPN and EPF files, with the member's own clearing number as the TM code, within BSECL's cut-offs (earlier ones on running-account settlement days). Built from the notice's description, not from a published file layout: ICCL has not published this file's column layout. The broker must confirm the field order, names and file name against ICCL's file description (member extranet) before the first upload.
